products.product: Vortex X10 ECU - KTM/Husqvarna OEM map switch functions
products.what_it_changes: With a Vortex the stock KTM/Husq switch: white = Map 1, green = map on the X10 dial; hold TC+QS 1 s for launch mode (rev limit, timing and fuel vs rpm/TPS/acceleration; 2nd gear, on limiter); traction control trims ignition on wheelspin; quick shifter cuts load for clutchless upshifts.
products.notes: Distributor how-to page; model years not stated (assumed bikes with the 2023-style switch).

products.product: Engine Mounts for 2023+ KTM (lower mounts, Ti bolt, upper hangers with separate exhaust mount)

fits.notes: Review says 2022.5+ SX-F generally; confirm size

products.what_it_changes: Adds compliance and comfort, better edge grip on flat hard corners; modest change.

feedback.finding: DirtBikeTest: easy install, better comfort and cornering, 'not a massive change', pricey.
Keefer (2023-24 450 SX-F): FCP named as a softer-mount option alongside WCL; not tested.

products.notes: Tester page, not maker page.

products.product: KX450 Engine Mounts (aluminum head stays + titanium front mounts)
products.what_it_changes: Two-position head stays plus Ti front mounts: less vibration, better lean-angle traction, plusher over bumps; AMA stock-class legal.

feedback.finding: MXA (Josh Fout): KX450 improved more with these than any bike he'd tried them on; price is the main gripe; rear head-stay position cut bar vibration.

products.product: Kawasaki Engine Mounts (front brackets + top hangers)
products.what_it_changes: Front brackets Soft/Stiff and top hangers Soft/Medium/Stiff; stiffer = more precise and less rear wallow, softer = better bump absorption but vaguer.

feedback.finding: DirtBikeTest: dramatic change; Stiff/Stiff favorite; Soft tops needed a stiffer shock setting.

products.product: Honda CRF450R Engine Mounts (aluminum top + titanium front)
products.what_it_changes: Top mounts let the bike lean further with a planted, quicker-turning front; front mounts mainly soak braking bumps.

feedback.finding: Swapmoto (Wayne Ashby): top mounts helped on any track; fronts most noticeable as track got rough.

products.what_it_changes: Medium: less harsh slap-down, less peg vibration, more lean-angle grip (sag 103 to 105 mm). Soft: better on fast flat desert tracks.

feedback.finding: Keefer: medium mount the pick for most tracks; soft for fast desert.

gaps: Twisted Development: no published per-stage engine build price list or dyno figures; full race engines (ClubMX/HEP spec), mini engines and 2-stroke builds are quote-only. TD sells no engine mounts or chassis parts.

Twisted Development: no Triumph TF 250/450, no YZ450F/YZ250F stock-ECU remap (TD says it cannot flash YZ or RM-Z stock ECUs), and no 2-stroke Vortex mapping. Twisted offers RM-Z only via Vortex mapping plus the RM-Z250 manual tensioner.

Twisted Development: KTM 350 Stage 1 race head has no year range on the page; we assumed the 2023-25 generation. Several TD pages have title/body year mismatches (YZ450F Vortex 2023-26 vs 2023-25; YZ450F piston '20223').

Vortex Ignitions: vortexignitions.com now redirects to TokyoMods, and TokyoMods blocks scripted access (403), so there is no official Vortex X10 model/part-number matrix for 2020-27 MX bikes. Fitment comes from tuners' pages (TD, XPR).
2027 Honda CRF250R/CRF450R use a new harness and ECU plug, and per XPR no Vortex is available for them yet.
Jamie Ellis: his own site would not resolve. He works through Twisted Development (TD projects page), so his mapping is covered by the TD Vortex products.
WMR: Maptuner Nano is KTM-group only (Keihin 4T and TPI 2T 2016+). TBI 2-strokes need mail-in, and Honda/Yamaha/Kawasaki are listed as 'coming soon'. The per-model map list page did not render.

Hot Cams: hotcams.com now serves an unrelated site. Distributor catalog pages show no 2023+ KTM-group, 2021+ Kawasaki KX450, 2023+ YZ450F or 2021+ CRF450R cams, so Hot Cams coverage for current bikes looks thin or ended.
Kibblewhite: maker site unreachable, and dealer fitment tables are loaded by JavaScript, so no new 2020+ fitments were captured beyond what cooling_valvetrain.json already has.

Wiseco/Vertex by bike: blocked at wiseco.com and vertexpistons.com. Existing engine*.json already holds most Vertex kits. Wiseco is still missing 2024+ KX450, 2023+ KX250, RM-Z250/450, Triumph TF and 2023+ KTM 250/350.

Rekluse and Hinson: maker sites returned 403. Only dealer pages were used, so part numbers and prices are partial. Rekluse still needs model-by-model RadiusX/CX/TorqDrive kits for KX, YZ-F, RM-Z and Triumph.
GET (Athena): no new items beyond tuning.json, apart from XPR's GET-based Triumph TF450 ECU. A GET ECU/launch-control list for Honda, Kawasaki, Yamaha and Suzuki 2020-27 is still missing.
Dr. D: no ECU, mapping or engine product found. They appear to be exhaust-only, so nothing was added.
Xtrig: no engine or engine-mount products found (clamps/ROCS only, already in chassis.json).
Ride Engineering: no engine mounts or head stays exist in their sitemap. Only billet plugs, switches and a tach meter were found.
FCP Racing: the maker site (fcpracing.com) has no product JSON. Prices come from tests, and fitment for 2023+ KTM 250/350 is unconfirmed. The FCP CRF450R entry is already in chassis.json.
Works Chassis Lab: no maker-site data, and the KTM 2023+ WCL mount price is unknown. The YZ450F WCL hangers are already in chassis.json.
Luxon MX: the CRF450R, KTM-group and Suzuki engine mounts were not found (only Yamaha, Kawasaki, a discontinued CRF250R and a Ducati version are listed).
Pro Circuit: product pages carry no cam lift/duration or piston compression specs. KTM titanium valve and KTM/Yamaha clutch spring variant pages were not parsed.
Suzuki RM-Z and Triumph remain the thinnest: RM-Z has Pro Circuit parts, XPR Vortex and a TD tensioner; Triumph has the XPR GET ECU and TF250 piston, a Rekluse TF250X kit and a Ride oil cap.
not_done: Twisted Development apparel, stickers and the Ducati Desmo 450 Vortex and Beta RX 450F AiM ECU were skipped as out of scope.
XPR's Akrapovic and Twin Air resale listings were not added because they duplicate brands already in engine.json/engine2.json.
WMR's OEM-parts and bike-sales catalog (7,250 Shopify items, mostly Honda Power Equipment and KTM OEM) was not inventoried.
Vortex X10 dealer bundles (FMF/Yoshimura plus Vortex for EXC-F and CRF450RL) were skipped as dual-sport/enduro.

Feedback was gathered only for TD's flange, airbox kit, second injector, KX450 Vortex and 2T remap, the XPR 250F injector, PC packages/pistons, and the FCP/WCL mounts. Many other items have no tester feedback.
Precision Concepts, Slavens, Varner, Haeseker, R&D Racing and other engine builders were not searched this pass.
